question:
**Consider the following statements regarding BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) cooperation:**

1) It is based on mutual benefit and public-good-driven innovation.

2) It is governed only through annual Heads of State Summits. Which of the statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) cooperation is established on the foundation of mutual benefit, public-good-driven innovation, and sustainable development.
 
• The cooperation framework is designed to address common challenges faced by BRICS nations, such as energy security, healthcare, and climate change, while promoting inclusive growth.
 
• It is not solely governed through annual Heads of State Summits but includes several ministerial meetings, working groups, and collaborative initiatives to ensure effective coordination and implementation.
 
• BRICS STI cooperation emphasizes joint research projects, knowledge sharing, and capacity building among member nations: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• This initiative fosters collaboration in areas like technology transfer, innovation policy exchange, and the development of advanced technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Statement 2: It is governed only through annual Heads of State Summits**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect as BRICS STI cooperation is not limited to annual Heads of State Summits.
 
• The framework involves various mechanisms, including ministerial-level meetings, expert-level working groups, and joint initiatives in STI fields.
 
• Moreover, the BRICS STI Steering Committee plays a significant role in formulating strategies and monitoring progress.
 
 
 
• **About BRICS STI Cooperation**
 
 
• The initiative was launched to enhance collaboration between BRICS nations in science, technology, and innovation to solve global and regional challenges.
 
• Key focus areas include energy, climate change, water resources, biotechnology, and information and communication technologies (ICTs).
 
• The BRICS Young Scientist Forum (YSF) is an integral part of this cooperation, aiming to foster the exchange of knowledge among young researchers.
 
• BRICS STI Framework Program promotes joint multilateral research and development (R&D) projects in priority areas of mutual interest.
